newsitem.title: GREECE: Alico Eurobank Funds had 23bln drs inflows in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Alico Eurobank Funds had 23bln drs inflows in Jan.

text.p: Alico Eurobank Mutual Funds had net cash inflows of 23 billion drachmas in January bringing its total assets under management to 192.5 billion.
"These results were achieved without the active involvement of Interbank's branch network which will start selling our mutual funds in the second quarter of 1997," the fund management company said.
Eurobank acquired a majority stake in private Interbank in 1996.
Its three fixed income mutual funds made up 84 percent of the total assets under management.

Alico Eurobank expects the interest rate downtrend to bring one-year T-bill rates down to 8.5 percent by the end of the year. The bull run at Athens stock exchange will continue on strong volumes despite interim corrections.
It also sees a favourable market climate for a stronger U.S. dollar in the medium term based on expectations of lower interest rates in Europe.
Alico Eurobank's Greek growth fund which is 80 percent invested in equities rose 19.9 percent in January. Its main holdings included shares of National Bank, Alpha Credit Bank and Titan Cement.
Its balanced fund gained 5.9 percent in January while its dollar bond fund rose 4.0 percent.
